Cosplay isn't shameful, but it can be embarrassing because it's out of the ordinary and it draws attention to yourself. I'd say maybe ask your mum whether she knows what cosplay is, then explain it if necessary. Then ask her whether she understands why it might interest some people, even if it doesn't necessarily interest her. If you can get her to acknowledge that she understands why it might interest some people, then I'd imagine that would make it easier to tell her that you're interested in it. If she just doesn't get it, I suppose one tactic would be to confess that you're interested and then tell her that although you're interested, it can still be a bit intimidating or expensive or whatever your concerns or hesitations about it are, and then maybe say that you want her understanding and support, and then try to explain why you're interested, and then regardless of whether she understands it, ask her whether she'll help support you and your interests. Once you've got her commitment to support you, ask her whether she'll go shopping with you for materials.
